subject: Kickoff: BrightWave renewal & capacity increase
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@brightwave.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: BrightWave renewal & capacity increase

Hi Priya,

Hope youre well. Our annual renewal for BrightWave is coming up and wed like to kick off the conversation early so we can align on capacity needs and contract terms. A few key asks from our side: 

- Move from a 24-month commit to a 12-month term this cycle (prefers shorter term).
- Increase committed throughput by ~40% to support new product feature rollouts in Q4.
- Clarify procurement timeline: legal wants to move by end of June for budgeting reasons.

Can we schedule the renewal QBR the week of June 7? Were fairly flexible but would prefer mornings PT. Ive attached our usage report for the last 12 months (BrightWave_usage_May27.pdf) so you can see the spike were anticipating.

Also, if you could share a draft mutual action plan and an early sense of pricing for the uplift, that would be helpful for my internal stakeholders.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
BrightWave

Attachment: BrightWave_usage_May27.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@brightwave.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: BrightWave renewal & capacity increase

Thanks Emily for the heads up and for the usage file — helpful context. Happy to get this moving. Proposed next steps from Redwood: 

1) Draft a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones: proposal, security questionnaire, procurement review, contract amendment, signature. Ive attached our baseline MAP for the renewal (MAP_v1.xlsx) as a starting point.
2) Schedule a one-hour renewal QBR the week of June 7 — suggested windows: June 8 09:00 PT or June 9 10:00 PT. Please confirm which works for your team.
3) Technical/ops sync with Soojin to validate burst and uplift sizing, plus a short integration test window prior to go-live.
4) Procurement point of contact and target signature date so we can route commercial and legal work accordingly.

Jordan (AE) will drive the commercial proposal and Soojin (CS lead) will own the technical validation and runbook. Emily, can you share the procurement contact (and any internal approval deadlines) so we can map those into the MAP?

We can also provide an early pricing ballpark for a 12-month commit with the +40% throughput uplift; Ill flag that with Jordan and ask for a draft before the QBR.

Look forward to locking a time.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Manager, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-06-01T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: BrightWave renewal & capacity increase

++ technical notes / recommended guardrails ++

Thanks Priya and Emily. Quick technical readout and risk-mitigation suggestions before we finalize the MAP: 

- Burst capacity: we can support a temporary 60% burst above commit for up to 14 days with a pre-authorized overage cap. If BrightWave wants a sustained 40% uplift we recommend moving to a stepped commit (12-month commit with a 3-month evaluation/adjustment at month 6).
- Integration test window: recommend a 48-72 hour smoke window on a staging pool identical to production; we can reserve that on the week of final sign-off.
- Performance knobs: for the new feature patterns you described, we suggest enabling prefix caching + a small model quantization profile which typically reduces per-token cost ~15% with negligible quality loss in our internal evals. Jordan and I can model cost impact for the proposed uplift.
- Security/compliance: Ive attached the updated security Q&A (security-qa.pdf). If your legal or infosec needs an evidence package (SOC 2 artifacts, audit logs), let us know and well queue that.

Open questions for BrightWave: whos the procurement contact? Any blackout dates for June/July where a migration/test window would be impossible?

Proposed immediate deliverables: updated MAP (v1 -> v2) after procurement contact, initial pricing scenario from Jordan, and a proposed QBR invite once Emily confirms date.

Sooj
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: security-qa.pdf
